findings.title: Fragile test assumptions about history
findings.message: The test asserts that Features[3] is create-carriage after moving 'earlier', but the initial order places carriage at index 4. The assertion depends on a selected featureID that may not be set via View, which is fragile. Undo-after-marker also assumes marker changes are journaled, which is unverified against the model.
findings.suggestion: Verify that marker moves are journaled, or drop the Undo assertions that depend on that.

findings.title: Selected paused feature loses paused visual state
findings.message: The marker is rendered before item j==p.Marker, so item j is after the marker and therefore paused. This part is consistent. However, when Marker==len(Items) and an item is selected, the selected style overrides the paused style, so a paused selected feature loses its visual paused state; only the tooltip/AX reveal it. This is minor but a hidden state change.
findings.suggestion: Keep a paused cue (for example a dimmed foreground) on selected paused items.
